name: NotifySync
description:
🧪 JELLYFIN 12 BETA CHANNEL — Pre-release versions of NotifySync for testers on Jellyfin 12.0 and newer. Use the Jellyfin 12 repository for stable installs.

NotifySync transforms the Jellyfin interface by adding a native notification bell, inspired by major streaming platforms. Your users see the latest additions — Movies, Series, Music — without ever leaving their current page.
